item.title: Cross-Progression Is Coming To Hitman: World Of Assassination Next Month
item.description: Kill with convenience.If you happen to own Hitman: World of Assassination on multiple systems, then good news, because cross-progression is officially being added on 3rd February 2026.Announced via a blog post, you'll be able to carry over key progression across all relevant platforms, provided of course you actually own the game on multiple systems. This includes player level, unlocks, location mastery, campaign story progress, and more.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Donkey Kong Bananza's First DLC In-Game Event Of 2026 Is Now Underway
item.description: A Tropical Freeze feast.Nintendo is showing no sign of slowing down on the in-game events for Donkey Kong Bananza's Emerald Rush DLC, as the latest challenge is now underway.The 'Freeze Break' event kicked off today (20th Jan) and will be sticking around until 27th Jan at 7:59am GMT / 8:59am CET / 11:59 PT (26th) — so there's plenty of time to get in and grab the rewards.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Switch 2 Predicted To Follow In PlayStation And Xbox's Footsteps This Year With "Global Price Hike"
item.description: Research firm Niko Partners reveals what could drive an increase.Over the past year, both the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S have been hit with price increases. It's inevitably led to questions about the Switch 2 getting a price hike in the future.Although there has been no official announcement from Nintendo about a price increase at this stage, the video game business intelligence and consumer insight firm Niko Partners believes a "global price hike" for the new system is likely on the way

item.title: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD Gets A Free Switch 2 Update And Adds Dixie Kong
item.description: Download Version 1.1.0 for Switch and Switch 2 today!Nintendo has announced a free update for the Switch title Donkey Kong Country Returns HD and it's available today!This update comes with multiple improvements when playing the game on Switch 2, including enhanced resolution, higher-definition graphics, and faster load times. There's also GameShare support.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties Scores A Switch 2 eShop Demo This Week
item.description: Try before you buy.Last week, the PlayStation Blog revealed a demo for Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties would be released on PlayStation 5. It's now been officially confirmed for the Switch 2 and multiple other platforms.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Rumour: Bethesda Is Reportedly Reviving Two More Fallout Games
item.description: Update: Just don't expect them any time soon.:Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition is on its way to the Switch 2 this year, and it might not be the only Fallout game returning in the future.
